data.claim: The August 21 announcement states that Gary Siders Jr., Elizabeth Siders, and Christina Siders were each indicted on 19 child-endangerment counts (two F2, 10 F3, seven M1), while Gary Siders Sr. was indicted on 16 counts (10 F3, six M1). The announcement says some counts are charged in the alternative.
data.notes: Protected-minor identities and re-identifying details are excluded. Aggregate counts are retained only to represent the public charge structure.
